answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The atlas cap is upheld at intake and pigment makes public the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a beacon tag. That is 25 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
